subject: general
question: According to Coffee Board of India, which of the following states in India is the largest producer of coffee in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Karnataka** became the **largest coffee-producing state** in India in 2020. 
 
• The largest coffee production in Karnataka is in **Kodagu (Coorg)** district.
 
• About** 71% **of india's coffee is produced in karnataka.

 
• **Kerala** is the second highest coffee producing state in India around 21%.
 
• After Kerala, Tamil Nadu is the Third highest accounting 5% of total production .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Karnataka is the** Third largest** producer of **Rubber.**
 
• Also **Sixth largest** producer of **Cashew**.
 
• Out of the total pepper produced in India, Around **50%** is from** Karnataka.**
